standard_prerequisites.use: X' x_X X_i -> X' stays locally of finite type.

standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme-level standard ph refinement
standard_prerequisites.use: The doubled family in (2) is refined by a standard ph covering.

core_obligations: (1) is clear: an isomorphism gives a standard ph covering itself.

(3): for h': Z -> X' with Z affine, set h = g o h'; the ph covering property at h gives a standard ph covering {Z_j -> Z} with Z_j -> X_{i(j)}; the universal property of the fibre product lifts these to Z_j -> X' x_X X_{i(j)} over h', so {X' x_X X_i -> X'} is a ph covering.

(2): for h: Z -> X affine, iterate the covering property twice to get {Z_{j,l} -> Z} with Z_{j,l} -> X_{i(j)j(l)} covering h; refine the family by a standard ph covering via the scheme-level lemma; hence the composite family is a ph covering.
proof_roadmap: Universal-property transfer for base change; double covering property plus standard-ph refinement for composition.
difficulty_reason: Three-part topology axiom check with two non-trivial verifications: (2) needs the refinement lemma, (3) needs the universal property.
